overview_description.description:
nGrow is a no SDK solution for push notification marketing.
nGrow is offering no code integration to Google Firebase, Amplitude and other analytical platforms
With nGrow AI tool, customers see up to 30% incremental Revenue growth helping follow iOS15+ and Android push notification policies.
The company was founded by a Marketing Director and a Tech co-founder, with 8+ years of experience in connecting AI and marketing across 40+ apps. 
We launched nGrow in November 2021, and now it delivers 150M notifications daily.
We’re backed by Y Combinator and ex-Dropbox and ex-Google investors.

about_short_description.short_description: nGrow.ai is an AI-driven customer engagement platform with no SDK.

product.name: AI-Driven Customer Engagement Platform
product.description: A platform that automates and optimizes customer engagement through AI-powered push notifications, email automation, and lifecycle marketing without requiring SDK integration.

product.name: Push Notification Automation and Optimization
product.description: A service that automates push notification campaigns with AI-driven content generation, delivery time optimization, and real-time A/B testing to enhance user engagement and retention.

product.name: Behavioral Segmentation and Predictive Analytics
product.description: A tool that segments users using any data from mobile analytics platforms and applies machine learning to predict user behavior and churn for targeted marketing.

product.name: In-App Messaging
product.description: A feature that delivers contextually relevant messages within mobile apps to guide users, provide personalized recommendations, and gather feedback during app usage.

product.name: Real-Time Analytics and Reporting
product.description: A system that tracks and reports detailed engagement metrics of push notifications and campaigns, including user interactions beyond clicks, to measure true customer engagement.
